user.title: Sign in to Bright
user.description: Use the email and password of the Bright app, Hildebrand Glow's free smart-meter app. Your meter must already be set up in the app and sharing its data. This integration is independent and not affiliated with Hildebrand or Glow.

data_description.username: The email you sign in to the Bright app with.
data_description.password: Your Bright app password. It is stored in Home Assistant only.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Bright
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} is no longer working. Enter it again to reconnect.

meters.title: Your meters
meters.description:
Bright found these meters, and this is how far each one's data reaches. Readings arrive half-hourly, 30 minutes to two days late; a meter with no readings yet fills in on its own once they arrive.

{meters}

data_description.sites: Each Bright site is one property. Untick any you do not want in this Home Assistant.

history.title: How much history
history.description: On the first pass the integration imports past readings into the Energy dashboard, each hour where it happened. After that it re-reads the last week every 30 minutes, so late readings fill in by themselves.

data_description.backfill_days: 365 imports a year, if Bright holds that much. You can change it later in the integration's options: raising it rebuilds the history from the new depth.

energy.title: Energy dashboard

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Bright (api.glowmarkt.com). Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Bright rejected those details. Use the same email and password as the Bright app.
error.no_meters: Signed in, but this account has no electricity or gas meter yet. Finish setting up your meter in the Bright app first.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Bright account is already set up.

init.title: Bright options
init.description: How many days of history to import. The last week is re-read on every pass, because readings arrive late.

data_description.backfill_days: Raising it clears the imported history and rebuilds it from the new depth. Lowering it keeps what is already imported.
